label: Bubble Meter
author: Conky-Studio
description: Vertical tube with rising bubbles; fill height follows Value. Decorative capacity / tank gauge.
lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local min_v, max_v = {min_value}, {max_value}
 local span = max_v - min_v; if span == 0 then span = 1 end
 local pct = ((tonumber({value}) or min_v) - min_v) / span
 if pct < 0 then pct = 0 elseif pct > 1 then pct = 1 end
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 local lr, lg, lb = {color}
 -- tube
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {opacity} * 0.8)
 rounded_rect(cr, x, y, w, h, w/2)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- liquid
 local fill_h = h * pct
 cairo_save(cr)
 rounded_rect(cr, x, y, w, h, w/2)
 cairo_clip(cr)
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, lr, lg, lb, {opacity} * 0.85)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x, y + h - fill_h, w, fill_h)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 -- bubbles
 local nb = math.floor({bubbles} + 0.5)
 local t = wall_clock()
 for i = 1, nb do
  local seed = i * 17.13
  local bx = x + w * (0.2 + 0.6 * ((math.sin(seed) * 0.5 + 0.5)))
  local speed = 12 + (i % 5) * 4
  local by = y + h - ((t * speed + seed * 10) % (fill_h + 10))
  if by > y + h - fill_h and by < y + h then
   local br = 1.5 + (i % 3)
   cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, {opacity} * 0.35)
   cairo_arc(cr, bx, by, br, 0, 2 * math.pi)
   cairo_fill(cr)
  end
 end
 cairo_restore(cr)
